finding: F2 selection record section 12.5 row 14; 05-work-agents-skills.md section 9
case: An acceptance transition with an empty resolution reason.
why: Section 12.5 row 14. Producer-declared completion is not acceptance, and an acceptance with no reason is an interval that timed out wearing a decision's name. The mutation deletes the value test and leaves the field-presence and the `!= ""` conjuncts -- which is the interesting case, because two of the three tests survive and the message must still name the one that went.
